plainText:
Romi Park (Japanese: 朴璐美 Park Romi), also known as Romi Paku, is a Korean-Japanese voice actress for . She was born on January 22, 1972 in , .

==Pokémon roles==
Park is most noted for providing the voice of 's younger brother, Forrest. She also voices various characters of the day. Her most recent role was Cyllene in the Pokémon: Hisuian Snow animated web series.
